links.comparator_used: Non-IBD-expert physicians scoring the videos without AI support (AI alone was also compared with experts)
links.outcome: Accuracy of UC endoscopic severity (Mayo Endoscopic Subscore) classification by non-IBD experts, with expert scores as gold standard
links.effect: AI as a supporting system improved non-IBD experts' performance by 12%; AI alone reached 82% accuracy with no significant difference from experts; AI disagreed with the primary physician in 20%-39% of cases
links.tradeoff: The AI disagreed with the primary physician in 20%-39% of cases, which triggers second-opinion reviews. No other cost or burden was reported.
links.quote: When used as a supporting system, it improved non-IBD experts' performance by 12% and disagreed with the primary physician in 20%-39% of cases.

design_hint: AI as second-opinion support for endoscopists (human-AI decision support)
